title: Nuclei Preparation from Frozen Mouse Brain Tissues for Single Nuclei RNA-seq
author: Greggory A A Perry
materials: Debris removal from nuclei with Sucrose Column Purification
Debris removal from nuclei with Miltenyi Anti-Nucleus Beads

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Nuclei Extraction
steps.instruction: Dissociate frozen mouse brain tissue using the gentleMACS system without allowing samples to thaw.

substeps.instruction: Add 1250 µL ice-cold Nuclei Extraction Buffer to pre-cooled gentleMACS C Tubes.
Transfer frozen tissue pieces into the tubes.
Close the caps completely and place tubes in the gentleMACS Dissociator (e.g., Octo Dissociator with Heaters, Miltenyi Biotec 130-096-427).
Run the gentleMACS Program based on tissue size at 4 °C.
Perform a quick spin in a swinging bucket at 500 x g, 4 °C, for 10-15 seconds if necessary.

steps.title: Initial Nuclei Recovery
steps.instruction: Collect and filter the extracted nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend nuclei in 500 µL Nuclei Suspension Buffer (if the pellet is loose, leave 50 µL Nuclei Extraction Buffer in the tube).
Pipette the mix with a wide-bore tip and filter through a pre-wet (with Nuclei Extraction Buffer) 70µm or 100µm filter into a cold 2mL tube.
Rinse the filter with 250 µL Nuclei Extraction Buffer.
Spin in a benchtop centrifuge for 5-10 seconds to remove foam if necessary.
Spin down nuclei at 500 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes in a swinging bucket.

steps.title: Debris Removal (Sucrose Column Method)
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei using a sucrose gradient to remove white matter and debris.

substeps.instruction: In a 2mL microcentrifuge tube, layer 500 µL of sample on top of 750 µL Sucrose Buffer to form two layers.
Spin down at 16,000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes in a fixed angle rotor.
Carefully pour off or aspirate the supernatant/debris (which should float midway), leaving the nuclei pellet at the bottom.
Resuspend the nuclei pellet in 50-150µL Nuclei Suspension Buffer and let sit on ice without pipetting for 3-5 minutes.
Gently pipette mix 10-15x with a wide-bore tip and filter through a pre-wet (with Nuclei Suspension Buffer) 40μm filter into a new cold 1.5mL tube.
Repeat the resuspension and 40μm filtration steps for a total of 2 washes.
Centrifuge in a swinging bucket at 350 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Nuclei Counting and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify nuclei and assess integrity using one of the following counting or imaging methods.

substeps.instruction: Luna FX7: Mix 1uL AOPI stain with 9uL suspended nuclei (or 1ul AOPI/4.5ul sample/4.5ul buffer). Count using fluorescence settings for cell lines/primary cells.
Countess FL II: Mix 6 uL Trypan Blue (0.4%) and 6 uL nuclei suspension. Load 10 uL into chamber slide, visually assess at 20x magnification, and count.
Nexcelom Cellometer K2: Mix 11 uL AOPI stain and 11 uL nuclei suspension. Load 20 uL into SD100 slide and count.
Leica DM4 B QC: Dilute Hoechst 1:80 and SYTO RNASelect 1:500 in PBS. Mix 1ul of each dilution with 18ul nuclei suspension. Incubate at 4 °C for 20 minutes in the dark before imaging.

Opera Phenix QC: Dilute SYTO RNASelect 1:1000 and Hoechst 1:100 in DPBS. Add 1 uL of each diluted stain to 20 uL nuclei suspension. Transfer to 384-well plate and incubate at 4 °C for 20 minutes in the dark before confocal imaging.

steps.title: Final Suspension Preparation
steps.instruction: Adjust nuclei concentration for downstream applications.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant, leaving up to 30 µL to avoid loss.
Add the calculated volume of Nuclei Suspension Buffer based on downstream needs.
Mix 15-20 times with a wide-bore pipette and pass through a pre-wet 40 µm filter.
Perform a final count to determine number and viability.

steps.title: Optional: Miltenyi Anti-Nucleus Bead Clean-Up
steps.instruction: Further purify nuclei using magnetic beads to remove remaining debris.

substeps.instruction: Distribute 10^6 nuclei into 5 mL tubes; adjust volume to 450 µL using Nuclei Separation Buffer with RNase Inhibitor.
Add 50 µL Miltenyi Anti-Nucleus Microbeads per 10^6 nuclei; vortex at speed 3 for 5 seconds.
Incubate at 4 °C (not on ice) for exactly 15 minutes.
Spin down in a swinging bucket at 500 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 450 µL Nuclei Separation Buffer.
Mix 15-20 times with a wide-bore pipette and filter through a pre-wetted 40 µm filter into a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Optional: LS Column Purification
steps.instruction: Use LS columns to further refine the nuclei population.

substeps.instruction: Place LS columns on a magnetic stand with 15 mL waste tubes.
Add 3 mL Nuclei Separation Buffer (without RNase Inhibitor) to columns 3 minutes before loading.
Add 2 mL Nuclei Separation Buffer with RNase Inhibitor to samples and vortex at speed 3 for 5 seconds.
Load samples into LS columns and wash 2-3X with 1 mL Nuclei Separation Buffer with RNase Inhibitor, rinsing sidewalls.
Remove column from magnet, place in collection rack, and elute with 1 mL Nuclei Separation Buffer with RNase Inhibitor directly into the center of the column.
